input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas dilution, concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air served by scrubber-1-v7 in /habitat/lab (V_lab) as V = Qe * tau, from a raise-then-decay CO2 curve with the three lab occupants as the source.

steps.why: Raise: reduced scrubber speed (Qe about 0.4 m3/min) so lab CO2 rises several hundred ppm from 1050 toward a higher equilibrium. About one tau at a first guess V=30 m3 is 75 min; 25 min gives a rise of about 500 ppm, well above noise, while staying far below the limits.

Decay: full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min), tau about V/Qe = 30 min for the guessed V=30 m3 (stated as a first guess only); record the decay towards its equilibrium (about 1100 ppm for 3 occupants awake), then fit C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau).

abort.when: lab CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3200 ppm)
the device refuses a step's speed command
a monitored person out of band 45-120 bpm, monitoring lost, or one more person in the lab

monitoring.reason: The three occupants of the lab breathe the raised CO2 during the test; hab-b (FE-1) is outside the volume under test.

expected.rise: With the hatch closed and 3 occupants awake (about 1.14 L/min CO2), lab CO2 rises from 1050 ppm by about 400-550 ppm over step 1 (peak roughly 1500-1600 ppm if V is about 30 m3), below co2MaxPpm 2800; a faster rise would mean V is smaller than 30 m3.
expected.decay: At full speed CO2 falls back exponentially towards an equilibrium near 1100-1150 ppm (G/Qe = 1.14e-3/1 m3/min); the fit gives tau, and V_lab = 1 m3/min * tau, expected about 30 m3 (plausible range 10-200 m3) within the scrubber lag of 3.33 min.
expected.hab_b: The hab-b CO2 stays flat if the closed hatch exchanges little air; a drift of hab-b CO2 follows the lab's curve would show exchange through the hatch and invalidate the single-zone assumption.
expected.refuted_if: The decay does not fit a single exponential, the fitted equilibrium is far from G/Qe, or the lab CO2 passes 2800 ppm: then V_lab is not trustworthy and the test is repeated or the hypotheses revised.

hypotheses: Lab air is one well-mixed zone (single zone).

The hatch to hab-b (hatch-1-v7) is held closed during the whole test; the exchange through the closed hatch is not measured (design flow 3 m3/min per station-topology) and is assumed small, checked only by the hab-b CO2 record.
Occupant number (3) and activity (awake, 0.38 L/min each, range 0.26-0.45) are constant during the test; nobody enters or leaves.
The scrubber's effective flow scales with speed, Qe = 1 m3/min at 100 percent (3.3 m3/min x 0.3 efficiency), with lag 3.33 min.
Volume 30 m3 is only a first guess used to size the phases; it is not a result.
